connections.why: Calculations rely on understanding place value and operation order
Percentages are fractions out of 100 written as decimals
Square roots arise when finding side lengths from areas
Solving equations requires manipulating algebraic expressions
Linear sequences plot as straight lines on a graph
A line graph is the set of solutions to a linear equation
Rotations and reflections preserve angles in polygons
Surface area sums the areas of a 3D shape's faces
Proportion is a statement that two ratios are equivalent
Probabilities are written as fractions or decimals between 0 and 1
Sample space diagrams list outcomes used to compute probability
Graphs visualise distributions whose centre averages describe
Pie charts represent proportions as percentages of 360°
